selection: Before observing new comparator outputs, retain the earlier Vibe pilot rule: first utterance from the first ten distinct speakers in each fixed clean/other manifest.
models: MacWhisper 15.8 free WhisperKit Small; OSpr verified v0 Whisper Small. Same upstream model family, different conversions/runtimes; record actual settings before processing.
input: Identical original public files; no preprocessing in the comparison harness. Per-product internal behavior must be recorded separately.
scoring: Lowercase, remove punctuation, collapse whitespace; identical shared WER rule. Keep all raw texts and errors.
timing: Do not use Cua action/observation wall time to rank inference. Retain app-reported timing only with its documented boundary; model preparation/download excluded and recorded separately.
prohibited_claims: No microphone, dictation, hotkey, insertion, energy or top-three ranking from file-import results.
Twenty read-speech cases do not establish broad language or meeting accuracy.
